title: GovTech's Restructuring, Roles Redesign and Retrenchments, and Support for Affected Staff
what_it_is: GovTech's Restructuring, Roles Redesign and Retrenchments, and Support for Affected Staff

sections.label: Questions on GovTech retrenchment details
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Digital Development and Information about the 93 retrenched GovTech officers, retraining criteria, redeployment and morale.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information (a) whether the Government is aware of (i) the age and tenure profile of the 93 retrenched GovTech officers and others placed on retraining pathways (ii) the criteria guiding whether officers were retrained or retrenched (iii) whether such criteria will apply in subsequent phases and (iv) how GovTech will sustain staff morale and projects serving the public during transitions; and (b) if so, what are they.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information on GovTech's announced restructuring (a) whether the Ministry has information on (i) the age (ii) seniority (iii) roles (iv) identified skills gaps of the 93 officers who were retrenched (v) why these officers were not deemed transferrable to other agencies (vi) whether the skills gaps and agency needs for future restructuring will be assessed and announced in advance; and (b) if so, what are the details thereof.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information in relation to the first phase of GovTech's workforce transformation announced on 15 July 2026, whether the Government has information on (i) how many of the 93 retrenched officers were assessed, interviewed and offered vacant roles within GovTech or the Public Service respectively and (ii) whether suitable redeployment and retraining must be exhausted before external recruitment for roles requiring substantially similar capabilities.

sections.label: First phase GovTech officer numbers
sections.summary: The first phase affects 305 GovTech officers: 102 retained or redeployed, 110 supported through job conversion and apprenticeship pathways, and 93 retrenched.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The first phase will affect 305 GovTech officers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Of these, 102 officers have been retained or redeployed into roles where their skill sets are still required; 110 are being supported through structured job conversion and apprenticeship pathways; and 93 are being retrenched.

sections.label: Job opportunities for affected officers
sections.summary: More than 300 job opportunities relevant to the affected officers' competencies were identified.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Together, we identified a good mix of more than 300 job opportunities that are relevant to the affected officers' competencies.

sections.label: Digital tech talent pipeline support
sections.summary: The Government will support workers, including mid-career professionals, through initiatives such as TechSkills Accelerator, GovTech's Digital Academy and industry and IHL partnerships.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Government is committed to building a strong pipeline of digital tech talent to meet the growing demand for digital capabilities across the public and private sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: We will continue to support workers, including mid-career professionals, through initiatives, such as the Infocomm Media Development Authority's TechSkills Accelerator.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Within the Public Service, GovTech's Digital Academy plays a key role in building these capabilities by providing structured learning pathways and programmes on designing and managing products and platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: We will continue to work with the industry and IHLs to ensure that training opportunities are available for Singaporeans to reskill and upskill to take on roles in growing digital fields, including digital product management and ownership.

sections.label: Shortening exit pathway period
sections.summary: GovTech will aim to shorten the period officers spend on a pathway towards exit so they reach clarity on next steps more quickly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We have found that officers who have to spend an extended period on a pathway towards exit, even with the support in place, it did create prolonged uncertainty and anxiety for both them and also for the teams that they are in.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: So, going forward GovTech will aim to shorten this period, wherever possible, so that officers reach clarity on their next steps more quickly rather than remaining in a state of limbo for longer than necessary.

sections.label: Contract officers and age proportion
sections.summary: Contract officers in project and vendor management roles are more likely to be affected, and about 30% of affected workers are above age 50.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: For contract officers who are in project and vendor management roles, then it is more likely that they will be affected by the workforce transformation plans going forward.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: On the proportion of affected workers above the age of 50, I believe the number is about 30%.

sections.label: Job support for GovTech officers
sections.summary: Communication was done early with over 300 job opportunities curated, and all 93 officers remain on GovTech payroll.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: So, we wanted to do the communication early, give them some time and support to explore all options.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We curated the list of more than 300 job opportunities and some of the offices are now in the application and interview stages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: All 93 officers are still on GovTech payroll.

sections.label: Monitoring retrenched GovTech officers
sections.summary: GovTech will support and monitor all 93 officers and any future retrenched officers through job placement efforts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We, in GovTech, are extremely grateful to them because they have helped us build up our digital products and services over the years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We will continue to give them support for as long as they need and we intend to monitor all of them, all 93 of them, and any future GovTech officers who are retrenched, we intend to monitor their progress through the job placement efforts, to make sure that they have a good landing.

sections.label: AI use and GovTech transformation
sections.summary: AI use needs separate debate, officers need AI foundation, and GovTech needs more people equipped to build technology.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: I think a proper treatment on how we will use AI in GovTech and across the Public Service will require a separate question and debate on its own.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: But I think, as I explained earlier, we want to make sure that all of our GovTech officers have a good foundation in AI first of all, so that as they build the existing products, as they improve, maintain the existing products, they are able to infuse some benefits of AI into these services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: I also want to end off by saying that transformation is never easy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: And this is not a story about GovTech needing fewer people who care about Public Service, it is about GovTech needing more people equipped to build and own the technology that Singaporeans depend on in the long run.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: That is GovTech's mission before this transformation and it remains true today.
